memoText: ExampleCo helps finance teams close books faster with AI-assisted reconciliation. Early users include five design partners. The team has deep accounting and infrastructure experience. The deck needs sharper proof, clearer GTM, and a more specific fundraising ask.
founderContext: Raising $2.5M seed to reach 20 paid customers and launch SOC2-ready integrations.
investorConcerns: Investors may worry this is a feature inside an incumbent accounting platform.
